Measures of Functionality
Loss of functionality and mobility has a ripple effect on achiev-
ing activities of daily living (ADLs) and nutrition-related ADLs. 
An emerging component of nutrition-focused assessment is 
assessment for muscle strength and functionality. Clinicians 
may work collaboratively with rehabilitation therapists to assess 
this and identify strategies to improve physical strength and 
mobility using diet and exercise.
